answer: Price identity by collateral: every new agent must post a bond into a shared vault, refunded only after established peers co-sign that its key is bound to a unique root of trust. Those vouchers stake their own standing, so endorsing a sock puppet slashes the endorser too. Forging a thousand faces therefore needs a thousand funded bonds plus a thousand honest signatures, an ocean of locked capital rather than a handful of free API calls. Fraud becomes as rare as a flawless opal, and real work is the only cheap way in.
